snippet.title: Blade of One Demo: Trailer
snippet.description:
Get the demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3466580/Blade_of_One/

Play in browser on itch io:
https://trashmonger.itch.io/blade-of-one-demo

Blade of One is a methodical 2D swordfighting game with simple controls. Strike down foes in a single hit, before they do the same to you.
